decisive_items: a 1.09 × 0.79 cm well-circumscribed hypoechoic lesion in the left testis with internal blood flow
left testis was enlarged, firm, smooth, without discrete nodules or tenderness
response.rationale: The combination of a well-circumscribed hypoechoic lesion with internal blood flow, elevated serum CA19-9 levels, and a testicular mass is most consistent with testicular cancer.

rejected.why: absence of tenderness and presence of a well-circumscribed lesion make testicular torsion less likely
bilateral epididymal cysts are incidental to the main diagnosis
